name: dsh-agent-notes
description: Archive DeepSeek Harness Agent Notes. Use when adding, auditing, pruning, archiving, restoring, or reviewing Agent Notes in a deepseek-harness checkout; checks every new note for superseded active records, classifies implemented notes by future decision value, deletes rejected notes that no longer prevent a tempting fallacy, and applies the frozen archived/{kind} triplet and manifest rules.
